text: Call Issued: May 1, 2015 Call Closed: June 10, 2015 Number of Addenda Issued: One (1) Number of Bids: Seven (7)

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (April 12, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: National Joint Power Alliance Request for Proposal Number 061015-GPC Description: For the supply and delivery of fleet-related maintenance equipment, supplies, services and inventory management solutions, from July 1, 2018 to July 20, 2019. If this contract is extended at National Joint Power Alliance's discretion, Fleet Services Division may continue to use the contract for an additional separate optional one (1) year period from July 21, 2019 to July 20, 2020.
